translationRepairs: Tian Dan pretended to bind his slave and followed some youths to the county court, intending to meet with the magistrate and kill the slave.
Tian Dan pretended to bind his slave and, accompanied by some young men, went to the county court, intending to request (as a pretext) that the slave be executed.

欲謁殺奴 means he meant to petition for the slave’s official execution, not to kill the slave himself; the next unit 因擊殺令 shows the magistrate is the one struck dead, so the proposed literal correctly restores that petition-pretext reading.
